name: Backlight through smoke
description: A proposed lighting arrangement for atmospheric product shots.
scope: Original finite-emitter authoring realization, not measured photometry. The complete JSON rig is authoritative; reference-origin HDR loses finite-source parallax and is a separately labelled projection.
preview_scope: Actual SolidCraft GPU image; 64 samples, denoised. Read the receipt/variant; this is not a convergence or full-physics claim.
limitations: Native GPU realization uses a finite rectangular emitter; a directional/spot angular model is retained as intent, not silently equated to a measured fixture.
Requires an explicitly bound volume/material; the light asset does not silently add an atmosphere or a water medium.
